summary: Advanced search over corpus chunks (/read/search): hybrid vector+lexical with tradition/text filters
description: Public semantic search page for the source library. The brains already exist: chunks.embedding (nomic-embed 768d, HNSW index), Ollama on the VPS embeds chat queries today, and retriever.ts already does hybrid vector+lexical retrieval with scope filters. Plan: /read/search server page — embed query via local Ollama (no API cost) → pgvector cosine top-k filtered by tradition/text (reuse the scope-section filter SQL) → optionally blend a websearch_to_tsquery lexical leg for exact-phrase queries. Results render as chunk cards linking into the reader. Public + unauthenticated, so add a simple per-IP rate limit to protect the VPS. No LLM in the loop — cost is one local embed per search.

resolution.note: Live-verified hybrid search with tradition filter + IP rate limit
